_comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment — business-rules-engine. Registers the RuleSets page only; NO top-level menu entry. Business rules exist only as part of an app (reached from within the app builder, not a global menu item) — the standalone /business-rules page stays routable for deep-links but is intentionally off the main nav. src/main.js mergeManifestFragments() concatenates pages onto src/manifest.json.

pages.title: Business rules
pages._note: Custom page hosting the business-rules engine dashboard (RuleSetsPage.vue). Lists RuleSets and opens the decision-table / condition-action editors and test sandbox. type:custom because the grid editors and sandbox are bespoke and no built-in page type covers them.
